prompt.alinti: Point your agent at any app and see how it works. It's called RIA, and it hands your AI assistant the job of taking software apart even when you don't have the original code. Ask it how a feature in an app works, and it reads the app's code, follows the trail, and explains each step with the evidence it found. It can even build you a version of that feature for your own project. Everything runs on your own computer, and nothing gets uploaded anywhere.

yontem.ne: AI agent kullanarak uygulamaların kodsuz olarak analiz edilmesi, işlevlerinin açıklanması ve özelleştirilmiş sürümlerinin oluşturulması.
yontem.alinti: Reverse Engineer Anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries. See a feature you like. Understand how it works, down to the binary level.

yontem.ne: Linux, macOS ve Windows (x64) için desteklenen bir dekompiler/analiz aracı.
yontem.alinti: Ghidra on Linux and macOS, plus an experimental Windows x64 Ghidra P0 for approved native PE applications.
